source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: During your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), whenever this model’s vibro cannon attacks an enemy unit, improve that attack’s Strength, Damage and Armour Penetration by 1 for every other **VIBRO CANNON PLATFORM** model of yours that has made at least one vibro cannon attack against that same enemy unit in this phase.
